internal_discovery.plain_explanation: All three occurrences are the same noun, differing only in number (singular جِذْع twice, broken plural جُذُوع once). In every token it is bound in construct to the palm (النخلة / النخل) and names the tree's rigid vertical woody trunk: the thing Maryam is driven toward and can lean on, the body she shakes so ripe dates fall, and the upright post Pharaoh threatens to crucify the magicians upon. Three different physical uses — lean-against, grasp-and-shake, affix-body-to — all presuppose one and the same property: a stiff, weight-bearing vertical column. The sense is scene-neutral, appearing identically in divine provision and in tyrannical cruelty.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: NOT the whole tree (always جِذْع OF the palm — a part, not the organism); NOT the fruit (19:25 names رُطَب جَنِيّ as a separate thing the trunk merely yields when shaken); NOT the crown, fronds, branches, or roots; NOT bound to any non-palm plant or object (100% palm collocation); does NOT entail life, vitality, or fruit-bearing (20:71 is a bare execution-post); carries NO moral, theological, abstract, or metaphorical valence; no animal/'young-in-prime' or any verbal sense is attested (zero tokens), so it is excluded Quran-internally.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 20:71 (فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ) uses جِذْع as a bare crucifixion-post in the Pharaoh/magicians scene — different narrative, plural morphology, and a functional shift from part-of-a-living-palm (19:23–25) to instrument of execution. It does not break unity: the referent is still the palm's woody upright column, and the difference is contextual use, not lexical meaning. Its real evidential value is as a negative boundary — it disproves any richer 'living/fruiting stem' account and confirms the bare 'upright woody bole' nucleus that is neutral to whether the palm is living or fruit-bearing.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: That the root denotes a generic 'trunk/stem of any tree' (or, more radically, that there is no analyzable root nucleus at all — جِذْع is simply a frozen concrete label for 'palm trunk'). layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: Three confirmed nominal tokens: 19:23:4:1 (ji*oEi, sg. gen., إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ), 19:25:3:2 (ji*oEi, sg. after bi-, بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ … تُسَٰقِطْ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا), 20:71:20:1 (ju*uwEi, broken pl., فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ). Form inventory 100% N; qac_verb_form null throughout.
layer_attribution.derivation: No derivational family exists to bridge: zero verbal, adjectival, or participial forms. The only morphological variation is ordinary count-noun number inflection (sg. جِذْع → pl. جُذُوع), which is not a semantic split.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: A single lexicalized concrete count-noun جِذْع/جُذُوع denoting the palm's rigid upright woody bole. The entire class is lexicalized-nominal, which per contract caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Narrative context supplies the scene-specific USE (destination/support in Maryam's labor; provision via shaking; execution-post under Pharaoh) but NOT the root meaning. These contextual roles are held apart from the root claim, which is the scene-neutral physical referent common to all three.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: No preliminary/final disposition conflicts arose; all three analyses independently reached the same single-nucleus reading and the same MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE ceiling. 20:71 was reconciled from a candidate 'second sense' to an adversarial boundary that confirms the nucleus.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No occurrence resists the account. The residual open question is not resistance but underdetermination: the 100% palm collocation and absence of any neighbour root leave 'palm-trunk specifically' vs 'generic trunk' unadjudicable Quran-internally, and any non-palm generalization is unattested-not-disproven.

An adversary pushes it as a second sense ('timber post/gallows-upright' vs 'stem of a growing palm'). It does not break unity; it functions as a negative-boundary confirmer.

hard_case_representation.rationale: There is no RESISTANT occurrence: all three tokens are internally contradiction-free under one nucleus. It is represented as an ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY hard case (not counterevidence, since it supports the account), so counterevidence_refs remains empty.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quranic occurrence of the root ج ذ ع (in any form) that is NOT in construct with النخلة/النخل — e.g., جِذْع of a non-palm tree, or a verbal/adjectival/abstract use — which would either broaden the sense beyond 'palm bole' (defeating the palm-bound scope) or introduce a second, unbridged sense.
rejection_condition.search_location: The full Quranic corpus for the root j*E beyond the three packet tokens (19:23, 19:25, 20:71); specifically any token whose head-noun in the construct is not النخل/النخلة, or any non-nominal surface form.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Confirm the candidate token's root assignment via qac_pos/qac_verb_form/form and root_id=j*E, then read its verse_text to check the construct partner and syntactic frame against the palm-bound, purely nominal pattern of the three attested tokens.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude look-alike roots and mis-segmentations (verify root_id, not surface resemblance); do not import classical-lexicon 'trunk/young-animal' senses as evidence (source policy QURAN-INTERNAL ONLY); distinguish genuine new collocation from mere number inflection of the same lexeme.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If a non-palm or non-nominal token is found, the REPRESENTATIVE/LEXICALIZED_CLASS judgment must be reopened: either widened to a generic-trunk root sense (potentially ROOT_GENERALIZATION) or split into an UNRESOLVED multi-class result if the new sense is unbridged; the palm-bound account would no longer exhaust the attestation.

reopen_conditions: If any Quranic token of root j*E is found with a construct partner other than النخل/النخلة (a non-palm trunk), reopen to test widening from 'palm bole' toward a generic-trunk root sense.

If any non-nominal form of j*E (a verb, participle, or adjective) is attested, reopen because the current LEXICALIZED_CLASS/nominal-only basis and the 'no abstract or verbal root sense' negative boundary would be falsified.

If a competing 'trunk/wood/stem' root (e.g. a token pairing جِذْع against ساق/خشب/أصل in-context) becomes available, reopen to test distinctiveness, which is currently untestable and is the reason the grade is capped at MODERATE.
